The '''Burning Plains''' were a region with heavy volcanic activity to the north of the [[Mensix Mining Facility/Legends|Mensix Mining Facility]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. [[Blistmok/Legends|Blistmoks]] and other [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] creatures could be found here.

The Burning Plains was a thin layer of crust floating on a sea of molten [[Magma/Legends|lava]]. [[Geologist/Legends|Geologists]] expected that a major [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] could cause the entire region to sink, leaving a gigantic lava [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] in its place.

==Behind the scenes==
The Burning Plains appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TBP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Burning Plains were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TBP" />
